properties.displayName: [variables('_solutionName')]
properties.descriptionHtml: The Keyring solution for Microsoft Sentinel provides ASIM Audit Event parsers, scheduled analytic rules, hunting queries and a workbook for monitoring Keyring's custom audit table (KeyringAudit_CL) and correlating it with Azure Key Vault diagnostic logs.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM filtering parser for Keyring
properties.query:
// ASIM Audit Event parser for Keyring's own audit events (KeyringAudit_CL).
// Schema: AuditEvent 1.0.0. Deployed as the function vimAuditEventKeyring
// by infra/sentinel/main.bicep, which also declares its parameters.
// One output row per table row, no joins, no time filter of its own.
// Sign-in and sign-out events (session.*) are left out: they belong to the
// Authentication schema, not Audit Event.
// Never a secret value: Keyring's table has none, so NewValue stays empty.
KeyringAudit_CL
| where not(disabled)
| where isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime
| where isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime
| where not(Action startswith "session.")
| where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(ClientIp, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
| where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or ActorUpn has_any (actorusername_has_any)
| where array_length(operation_has_any) == 0 or Action has_any (operation_has_any)
| where array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0
| extend Verb = tostring(split(Action, ".")[-1])
| extend EventType = case(
    Action in ("secret.reveal", "secret.copy.read", "certificate.download_private_key"), "Read",
    Verb in ("create", "upload", "import", "rotate"), "Create",
    Verb in ("delete", "purge", "cancel"), "Delete",
    Verb in ("set", "update", "rollback", "bulk_update", "write"), "Set",
    Action == "role.activate", "Enable",
    Action == "role.deactivate", "Disable",
    Action == "share.grant", "Enable",
    Action == "share.revoke", "Disable",
    "Other")
| where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in~ (eventtype_in)
| extend EventResult = iff(Outcome == "success", "Success", "Failure")
| where eventresult == "*" or EventResult =~ eventresult
| extend
    EventCount = int(1),
    EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventSubType = iff(Verb == "recover", "Recover", ""),
    EventResultDetails = case(
        Outcome == "denied", "Denied by Azure",
        Outcome == "refused", "Refused by Keyring",
        Outcome == "failed", "Failed",
        ""),
    EventOriginalResultDetails = ReasonCode,
    EventSeverity = case(
        Outcome == "refused" and ReasonCode in ("csrf", "cross_site"), "Medium",
        Outcome == "success", "Informational",
        "Low"),
    EventOriginalType = Action,
    EventOriginalUid = EventId,
    EventUid = _ItemId,
    EventProduct = "Keyring",
    EventProductVersion = KeyringVersion,
    EventVendor = "Keyring",
    EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
    EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
    Dvc = "Keyring",
    Operation = Action,
    Object = case(isnotempty(ItemName), strcat(Vault, "/", ItemName), isnotempty(Vault), Vault, "Keyring"),
    ObjectType = iff(isnotempty(Vault), "Cloud Resource", "Other"),
    OriginalObjectType = iff(isnotempty(ItemKind), ItemKind, iff(isnotempty(Vault), "vault", "")),
    ActorUserId = ActorObjectId,
    ActorUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(ActorObjectId), "AADID", ""),
    ActorUserAadId = ActorObjectId,
    ActorScopeId = ActorTenantId,
    ActorUsername = ActorUpn,
    ActorUsernameType = iff(isnotempty(ActorUpn), "UPN", ""),
    ActorSessionId = SessionRef,
    SrcIpAddr = ClientIp,
    HttpUserAgent = UserAgent,
    TargetAppName = "Keyring",
    TargetAppType = "Service",
    AdditionalFields = bag_pack(
        "ReasonCode", ReasonCode,
        "ItemVersion", ItemVersion,
        "KvRequestId", KvRequestId,
        "Reason", Reason,
        "Ticket", Ticket,
        "Role", column_ifexists("Role", ""),
        "RoleScope", column_ifexists("RoleScope", ""),
        "RoleDuration", column_ifexists("RoleDuration", ""),
        "NotifyType", column_ifexists("NotifyType", ""),
        "NotifyRecipientCount", column_ifexists("NotifyRecipientCount", int(null)),
        "NotifyRecipients", column_ifexists("NotifyRecipients", ""),
        "NotifyEventCount", column_ifexists("NotifyEventCount", int(null)),
        "RevealLimitFrom", column_ifexists("RevealLimitFrom", ""),
        "RevealLimitTo", column_ifexists("RevealLimitTo", ""),
        "SharePrincipalId", column_ifexists("SharePrincipalId", ""),
        "SharePrincipalType", column_ifexists("SharePrincipalType", ""),
        "ShareUntil", column_ifexists("ShareUntil", ""),
        "SharePath", column_ifexists("SharePath", ""),
        "WriterIdentityClientId", WriterIdentityClientId,
        "KeyringInstance", KeyringInstance)
| where array_length(object_has_any) == 0 or Object has_any (object_has_any)
| extend
    User = ActorUsername,
    IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
    Src = SrcIpAddr,
    Application = TargetAppName
| project-away Verb
properties.functionParameters: starttime:datetime=datetime(null), endtime:datetime=datetime(null), srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]), eventtype_in:dynamic=dynamic([]), eventresult:string='*', actorusername_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), operation_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), object_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), newvalue_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), disabled:bool=False, pack:bool=False

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for Keyring
Audit Event ASIM parser for Keyring
Audit Event ASIM parser for Keyring
Keyring: many secret reveals by one person

properties.description: Identifies when one person reveals secret values or downloads private keys through Keyring 20 or more times in 60 minutes. Looks back an additional 10 minutes to handle ingestion delay without double-alerting.
properties.displayName: Keyring: many secret reveals by one person
Keyring: secret revealed from a new address

properties.description: Identifies when a person reveals a secret value or downloads a private key through Keyring from a client IP address not seen for that person in the preceding 14 days. Only alerts for people previously observed in KeyringAudit_CL.
properties.displayName: Keyring: secret revealed from a new address
Keyring: one person denied in several vaults

properties.description: Identifies when Azure Key Vault denies one person through Keyring at least 5 times across 3 or more distinct vaults within 60 minutes, indicating possible access probing.
properties.displayName: Keyring: one person denied in several vaults
Keyring: sensitive action outside working hours

properties.description: Identifies a purge, private key download, bulk change or other watched Keyring action performed outside the organisation's working hours (default 08:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday, UTC+10).
properties.displayName: Keyring: sensitive action outside working hours
Keyring: forged or cross-site requests

properties.description: Identifies when Keyring refuses 5 or more requests from a single client IP address in 15 minutes as a forged form (csrf) or cross-site post (cross_site), indicating a possible attack on Keyring itself.
properties.displayName: Keyring: forged or cross-site requests
Keyring: secret shared with a guest, or many shares

properties.description: Identifies when a person shares a secret through Keyring with a guest account, or creates more than 5 secret shares in 60 minutes. A share is a Key Vault Secrets User role assignment made as that person.
properties.displayName: Keyring: secret shared with a guest, or many shares
Keyring: no audit events while Key Vault saw Keyring

properties.description: Identifies when no Keyring audit events arrive in KeyringAudit_CL for 6 hours while Azure Key Vault logs reads or changes from Keyring's outbound IP addresses, suggesting the audit sink is broken or disabled. Populate keyringOutboundIps in the query before enabling, and switch KeyVaultCalls to AZKVAuditLogs if your vaults use resource-specific diagnostics.
properties.displayName: Keyring: no audit events while Key Vault saw Keyring
Keyring: SecretGet from Keyring with no audit event

properties.description: Identifies a Key Vault SecretGet from Keyring's outbound IP addresses with no matching KeyringAudit_CL event. Populate keyringOutboundIps before enabling and verify CorrelationId matching on a real vault first (see docs/real-vault-checklist.md).
properties.displayName: Keyring: SecretGet from Keyring with no audit event
Keyring: secret values read
Keyring: secret values read

tags.name: description
tags.value: Lists secret values revealed through Keyring, with the actor, vault, item, client address, Key Vault request ID, reason and ticket. Set who at the top to filter by a person.

properties.displayName: Keyring: private keys downloaded
Keyring: private keys downloaded
properties.query:
// Certificate private keys downloaded through Keyring.
let who = "";
KeyringAudit_CL
| where Action == "certificate.download_private_key"
| where isempty(who) or ActorUpn contains who or ActorObjectId =~ who
| project TimeGenerated, ActorUpn, ActorObjectId, Vault, ItemName, Outcome, ReasonCode, ClientIp, KvRequestId, Reason, Ticket
| order by TimeGenerated desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Lists certificate private keys downloaded through Keyring, with actor, vault, item, outcome, client address, Key Vault request ID, reason and ticket.

properties.displayName: Keyring: deletes, purges and recoveries
Keyring: deletes, purges and recoveries
properties.query:
// Deletes, purges and recoveries of secrets, certificates and keys through Keyring.
let who = "";
KeyringAudit_CL
| where Action in ("secret.delete", "secret.purge", "secret.recover",
    "certificate.delete", "certificate.purge", "certificate.recover",
    "key.delete", "key.purge", "key.recover")
| where isempty(who) or ActorUpn contains who or ActorObjectId =~ who
| project TimeGenerated, Action, ActorUpn, ActorObjectId, Vault, ItemKind, ItemName, Outcome, ReasonCode, ClientIp, KvRequestId
| order by TimeGenerated desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Lists secrets, certificates and keys deleted, purged or recovered through Keyring.

properties.displayName: Keyring: refused and denied, by person
Keyring: refused and denied, by person
properties.query:
// What Keyring refused, or Azure denied, counted by person, vault and reason.
let who = "";
KeyringAudit_CL
| where Outcome in ("refused", "denied")
| where isempty(who) or ActorUpn contains who or ActorObjectId =~ who
| summarize Count = count(), LastTime = max(TimeGenerated), Actions = make_set(Action, 10), Addresses = make_set(ClientIp, 10)
    by ActorObjectId, ActorUpn, Vault, Outcome, ReasonCode
| order by Count desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Summarises requests refused by Keyring or denied by Azure Key Vault, grouped by person, vault, outcome and reason code.

properties.displayName: Keyring: one person's activity
Keyring: one person's activity

tags.name: description
tags.value: Returns every action recorded for one person in KeyringAudit_CL. Set who at the top to the person's sign-in name or Entra object ID before running.

properties.displayName: Keyring: Key Vault's log beside Keyring's
Keyring: Key Vault's log beside Keyring's

tags.name: description
tags.value: Correlates Azure Key Vault audit events (AZKVAuditLogs) with KeyringAudit_CL events for one vault using CorrelationId and KvRequestId. Set vaultName before running.
